questions.needs_revision: Do the critique findings show at least one item whose status is wrong or unsupported, so the result must be revised before it is used?
questions.positive_despite_gate: Does any sample that is missing a required metric or fails a hard gate receive include or flag_for_review?
questions.confounded_contrast_trusted: Does the result claim the retained design supports an interpretable treated-versus-control differential-expression contrast?
